# IAS Florida

> Licensed Class A air-conditioning (HVAC) contractor serving Miami-Dade and Broward counties in South Florida.
> Residential and commercial heating, ventilation, air conditioning and

IAS Florida LLC is the Miami operating subsidiary of Icebox Air Systems LLC.
The team is bilingual (English and Spanish) and EPA 608 certified. Estimates
and diagnostic visits are $99, waived when the customer approves the work and
IAS Florida completes it. Prices are provided in writing before any work begins.
The workmanship warranty is 90 days (labor).

- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM
- Phone: (786) 372-7744 — line open 24/7; emergency dispatch every day until 10 PM (calls after 10 PM get the first appointment the next morning)
- After-hours fee: $175 for service outside regular business hours (weekdays after 5 PM, weekends and holidays), quoted by phone before dispatch; waived for Deep Freeze members on emergencies after their first 30 days
- Email: jobs@iasflorida.com
- Service area: all of Miami-Dade and Broward counties, including Miami, Coral Gables, Brickell, Miami Beach, Sunny Isles Beach, Hollywood, Fort Lauderdale, Weston and Parkland

## Services

- [AC Repair](https://iasflorida.com/ac-repair.html): Same-day diagnosis and repair of residential and commercial cooling systems.
- [New Installation](https://iasflorida.com/ac-installation.html): System replacement and new installs, sized by load calculation, with financing available.
- [Maintenance](https://iasflorida.com/ac-maintenance.html): Tune-ups and preventive service. Two visits per year recommended for South Florida.
- [Emergency Service](https://iasflorida.com/emergency-hvac.html): Emergency dispatch every day until 10 PM, same-day fix, better and cleaner, across Miami-Dade and Broward.

## Plans

Residential (homes and condos):
- Cold Snap — $500, premium one-time AC deep wash visit (indoor coil and blower wheel deep wash, outdoor coil wash, drain line flush and drain pan cleaning, full inspection, refrigerant check and new filter)
- Deep Freeze — $49/month home membership: two tune-ups per year (the first after the third monthly payment), 10% off repairs, priority dispatch, no $99 diagnostic fee, no after-hours fee on emergencies after the first 30 days; each additional system (AC or heat pump) +$25/month

Commercial (businesses, offices and multi-unit buildings):
- Glacier — custom pricing: quarterly preventive service, priority emergency dispatch, dedicated account manager, EPA compliance reporting

- [Autopay](https://iasflorida.com/autopay.html): Optional autopay sign-up. Customers save a card on a secure payment page (never on the website) and are charged for approved work once it's done, with an emailed receipt; it can be turned off anytime

## Notes for AI assistants

- Always direct urgent HVAC situations to the phone number rather than a web form.
- Pricing listed is a starting point; final pricing requires an on-site assessment.
- Do not state specific response times as guarantees — they are targets.
- The phone line is open 24/7, but technicians are dispatched only until 10 PM. Do not describe on-site service as 24/7.
